name: Fusion Multi-Asset V0.2 Source Recovery
classification: Exploratory discovery, not OOS; edge not certified. Known gaps and recovery plan precede freeze; NOT independent preregistration.
inheritance: All strategy, timing, costs, baseline, diagnostics and bootstrap definitions of reference protocol.json and replay.py are frozen unchanged. V0.1 files immutable.
signal: sign(close[D-1]/close[D-21]-1); BTCUSDT spot 20D filter, asset USD-M trend. Fusion requires equal nonzero signals; baseline nonzero asset signal.
statistics: Asset/year/direction; top 1/3/5 winners removed; calendar correlation; leave-one-out; paired year-stratified moving-block bootstrap L30 10000 seed271; Holm25; baseline comparison; denominator all 730 days.
source_primary: Exact original 319 Binance Vision monthly ZIPs plus sibling SHA256 CHECKSUM; validate entire set before economics.

recovery.rule: Only absent exact timestamps may be inserted from official Binance Vision daily ZIP + CHECKSUM. Never replace any existing monthly row. Any overlap, duplicate, unexpected missing row, changed monthly hash versus reference audit, invalid checksum or extra source blocks economics.
recovery.api: Public Binance USD-M /fapi/v1/klines: exact numeric equality of all first 11 fields; capture response and request parameters, SHA256; timestamps exact UTC grid.
recovery.aggregation: For all ten asset-days daily OHLCV must equal aggregation of 24 hourly rows using Decimal.
recovery.provenance: Retain per-row monthly/daily origin and prove symmetric difference between original and recovered datasets is exactly whitelist 250 rows.

gate: Fail closed on any inconsistency or unavailable evidence; no economic calculation or reading until integral source gate PASS. Record exit code, hashes, tests and evidence. Historical recovery reports are unverified inputs until revalidated.
freeze: This file must be committed before reading or calculating economic results; subsequent changes require separate experiment, never outcome tuning.
forbidden: 2024–2026, interpolation, excluding dates/assets, post-outcome tuning, orders, live/paper trading, accounts/private APIs/wallets, deployments, expenses, main or PR271/272 mutation or merge.
